entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: An adventure-world plane with powerful, shifting mana and a constantly changing landscape called the Roil; the site of the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: The constant shifting and changing of Zendikar's landscape, which awakened as a defense against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Floating polyhedron-shaped rune-carved stones that Nahiri built into a planewide prison network for the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A subterranean chamber in Akoum where the imprisonment spell was concentrated, reactivated only by three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A geologically unstable, mountainous continent with a supervolcano at its heart.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A merfolk-dominated continent of reef-rock jungles and an inland sea.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city on Tazeem overrun by the Eldrazi, retaken and later rebuilt.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: The great capital city of the Kor empire, in Ondu.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Seven floating Kor structures built as strongholds above each continent, which fell over a century and rose again.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people who built an empire that turned authoritarian before its Skyclaves fell.

entities.name: The Three
entities.description: Nahiri, Sorin Markov and Ugin, who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker and Kor stoneforger who built the hedron prison, watched over Zendikar, was compleated by the Phyrexians and later uncompleated and desparked.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who lured the Eldrazi to Zendikar.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon planeswalker whose colorless breath bound the Eldrazi to the plane.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Hungry titan-led beings imprisoned on Zendikar and later released.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans imprisoned on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose creative force infected the Akoum cultists and who was destroyed in Zendikar's Last Stand.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan awakened by Ob Nixilis and destroyed in Zendikar's Last Stand.

entities.name: Zhulodok
entities.description: An Eldrazi from the first awakening, Ulamog's prophet, that razed the land until Nahiri slew it.

entities.name: Akoum cultists
entities.description: People of Akoum infected by Ulamog's influence who loosened the Eldrazi prison; twelve survivors became the first vampire bloodchiefs.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who visited Zendikar hoping hedron magic could stop Phyrexia but judged it insufficient.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An animist planeswalker who destroyed the keylock hedron, helped trap Ulamog and restored Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire scholar present with Nissa and Sorin at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who met in the Eye of Ugin, activated the hedrons against Ulamog and devised the plan to kill the Titans.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who took command of the defense of Zendikar.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker native to Zendikar who brought an army of merfolk and sea monsters.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who freed her friends and burned the Titans.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who reignited his spark by siphoning hedron power, destroyed the hedron network and awoke Kozilek.

entities.name: Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Nalaar and Beleren in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: General Tazri
entities.description: An angel-haloed commander who took command after the planeswalkers fell, led the rebuilding and fought Nahiri.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The vampire queen who joined Tazri's forces.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A Kor squad leader who joined Tazri's regrouped forces.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A character who brought news that Ulamog was approaching Sea Gate.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel who backed Tazri's plan and helped defeat Nahiri.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who swore an oath to stand together against threats.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war against the released Eldrazi.

entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi
entities.description: The event in which the Eldrazi prison was broken at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A device Nissa used to restore the soil and wild nature of Zendikar.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Zendikar was a target.

entities.name: Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whose demise halted the invaders.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The device whose incursion Nahiri facilitated by realigning the hedrons.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who turned the Emeria Skyclave into an engine and defeated Sea Gate.

events.summary: The Three decide to trap the Eldrazi on a plane and choose Nahiri's Zendikar for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana.
events.quote: They decided on Nahiri's own Zendikar .

events.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic, and Nahiri builds the hedron network that forms their prison.
events.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane

events.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
events.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

events.summary: Akoum cultists infected by Ulamog's influence perform rituals that loosen the Eldrazi prison.
events.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

events.summary: Zhulodok emerges in the first awakening and razes the land, causing a famine; only twelve cultists survive to become the first vampire bloodchiefs.
events.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race

events.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
events.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

events.summary: Urza visits Zendikar hoping hedron magic could stop Phyrexia but abandons the idea.
events.quote: He deemed the matrix's power insufficient, and so, he abandoned this idea.

events.summary: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar and Beleren at the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
events.quote: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar, and Beleren in the Eye of Ugin chamber loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor

events.summary: Nissa destroys the keylock hedron, completing the Release of the Eldrazi despite Sorin's intent to reseal the prison.
events.quote: Nissa instead acted by destroying the keylock hedron, and the Release of the Eldrazi was a fact.

events.summary: Within two years Sea Gate, Sejiri and Bala Ged are overrun in the Battle for Zendikar.
events.quote: Sea Gate on Tazeem and the entire continents of Sejiri and Bala Ged were overrun

events.summary: Gideon takes command and gathers allies including Malakir vampires, Noyan Dar Roil-mages and Kiora's merfolk army to retake Sea Gate.
events.quote: Gideon Jura took command, and started gathering allies to take the offensive.

events.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
events.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

events.summary: Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
events.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

events.summary: Ob Nixilis slaughters the Kor guards, siphons the hedrons' power to reignite his spark, destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
events.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

events.summary: General Tazri is saved by her halo and takes command of the regrouped forces.
events.quote: General Tazri was saved by the protection of her halo.

events.summary: Chandra frees her friends, they scare Ob Nixilis from Zendikar and swear an oath, creating the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus, they swore an oath to stand together, and the Gatewatch was created.

events.summary: Jace decides to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch and Kiora, devising a leyline plan with Nissa and using defenders as bait.
events.quote: Jace decided to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora's help.

events.summary: Chandra channels fire through Nissa and the ley lines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

events.summary: Tazri drafts her own rebuilding plan for Sea Gate, backed by the angel Linvala, and the city is restored within a year.
events.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

events.summary: Adventurers awaken the Emeria Skyclave and the other six, which rise back into the sky.
events.quote: all seven Skyclaves rose back into the air and opened

events.summary: Nahiri and Nissa clash over how to end the Roil, and Nissa prevails, restoring Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed, and restored the soil and wild nature of Zendikar by use of the Lithoform Core .

events.summary: The compleated Nahiri transforms the Emeria Skyclave into a Phyrexian engine and realigns the hedrons for Realmbreaker; Sea Gate falls again.
events.quote: As Phyrexians scurried into Zendikar, Sea Gate was defeated once more.

events.summary: Tazri's party, aided by Linvala and Halo, breaks Nahiri loose from the hedron network as the Skyclave crashes down with her inside.
events.quote: they witnessed the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

events.summary: Nahiri, uncompleated and desparked, tries to remove the metal from the Skyclave but lacks the power to restore the land.
events.quote: Nahiri, now uncompleated and desparked , worked to remove the metal from the Skyclave

relations.note: She built the network of stone hedrons that forms the prison.
relations.quote: Nahiri had constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

relations.note: One of the three planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: the three planeswalkers sealed the chamber with a mystical lock

relations.note: He took command of the defense and rallied allies.
relations.quote: Gideon Jura took command, and started gathering allies to take the offensive.

relations.note: He followed Nissa from Bala Ged and destroyed the hedron network as vengeance against Zendikar.
relations.quote: having followed Nissa from Bala Ged

relations.note: Her army fought alongside Gideon's troops at Sea Gate.
relations.quote: While Gideon's troops and Kiora's forces held the city against this fresh assault

relations.note: She backed Tazri's proposal and later fought beside her.
relations.quote: The angel Linvala immediately stood behind Tazri's proposal

relations.note: They disagreed on how to restore Zendikar, and Nissa opposed her.
Her flames, channeled through Zendikar's ley lines, destroyed the Titans.
relations.quote: allowing her to channel her pyromantic magic through Zendikar's Ley Lines directly into the Titans

relations.note: Imprisoned on Zendikar by the hedron network.
relations.quote: Emrakul, Ulamog, and Kozilek manifested in physical form on Zendikar
